Experience

A season of hands-on operations, high-stakes event coordination, and a front-row seat to how high-achieving professionals operate.

Operations & Events May 2022 – August 2024

Member Services & Pro Shop Attendant

Hawthorn Woods Country Club

Over three summers at Hawthorn Woods, I became a consistent, trusted presence at a club where Chicago-area executives unwind, close deals, and build relationships. Working directly with 200+ active members, I managed accounts, processed daily transactions, and was at the center of everything happening on and off the course — from coordinating weekly leagues to staffing private events.

200+ Member Accounts
20+ Events Coordinated
100+ Daily Transactions
3 Staff Trained
◎

Event Coordination

Helped set up and run recurring league events and one-off private functions — coordinating with staff, vendors, and members on timing, logistics, and day-of execution.

◎

Member Account Management

Managed 200+ member profiles across POS, membership database, and event booking systems — maintaining accurate records and handling billing, reservations, and requests.

◎

Team & Operations

Assisted in onboarding and training 3 new team members on system workflows, customer service standards, and operational procedures during peak season.

Unexpected Networking

Beyond the day-to-day, this role meant constant interaction with entrepreneurs, CEOs, and business leaders who were club members. I wasn't just processing their accounts — I was learning how to communicate with confidence, present myself professionally, and build genuine connections with high-achieving people. Those conversations shaped how I think about business more than any classroom.
